verdicts.note: The direction holds: she is the sitting clerk running for re-election and asks to 'continue serving' on her record [S1]. The magnitude is overstated. She was appointed in August 2021, has been elected once (unopposed in 2022 [S3]), and has worked in the office since November 2020 [S1], about six years in all. That is a one-elected-term record of the same depth as Commissioner Dean's in this county, which was scored -1 as 'a shorter record than a long-tenure case'. The -2 pole should go to long-tenure records like Maycumber's 11 years as sheriff and 25-plus in county law enforcement. Her statement also cites no specific accomplishments beyond general service [S1]. -1 at medium.

Tested toward +2 and toward 0. She has never held elected office and is challenging the incumbent [S1]. But she does not run as a change agent: her pitch is 'steady leadership' and 30 years of management plus more than 10 years in the Pierce County court system [S1]. That makes the outsider case partial, so +1 at medium is right. Her Wolf Advisory Group seat [S2] is not evidence on any County axis.
